evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected named owned body windows, source-selector leaf bytes and complete equality-only selector programs, enum/field/literal declarations and actual caller MethodSpec usage cells.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Reviewed parser/resolver/path callers, concrete constructor/reader stores, typed state-event joins and checked default objective-initializer/combined child-loop programs. No live admission, source-to-instance construction or chronology claim.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: ASCII source model; ordinary valid String/List/Stack/HashSet/array/helper semantics, successful allocation, generic context initialization and Win64 ABI; false IFix guards. Constant parameter resolution additionally requires coherent typed Param instances with paramSource zero.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: JSON-to-live Param initialization, live patches/objects/events, nested cached-result coherence and authoritative mission admission/order.

parameterResolution.idRefMinusOne: GetValue returns passed default for getter sources when idRef is -1
parameterResolution.normalConstantPath: TryGetValue copies typed constValue and returns true before blackboard/getter dispatch; GetValue reads its out slot
parameterResolution.stateCallerArguments: GetValue<T>(configured Param,default(T),true); typed result stored in matching cached field
parameterResolution.sourceInitialization: Value constructors explicitly select zero; full MemoryPack readers explicitly read the source. Neither proves the live source of an omitted JSON field.
parameterResolution.wrapperConstruction: Typed wrappers allocate a Param and set idRef=-1; a full MemoryPack deserialize subsequently overwrites all four serialized fields, including paramSource. JSON source omission remains a separate live-construction question.

nonconstant.sourceSelectorMeaning: sourceSelectors prove exact membership only, not a returned value. They are not a complete resolver switch: special current-source IDs use context keys and further dispatch.
nonconstant.referenceResolver: Reviewed complete registered reference GetValue/TryGetValue and path/cache bodies; ordinary initialized generic context and typed receiver required. Null Param, sentinel getter ID or false TryGetValue return select the supplied GetValue default.
nonconstant.boundVariable: Source 1 or 100 takes TryGetGetterValue; its selected reference body requires the bind flag and a nonnull stored getter. Missing binding returns false/default out. A successful delegate return is copied into out; delegate effects and current binding are live obligations.
nonconstant.getterReference: Sources -1/-2 use ActionContext and idRef to look up a typed getter. Failed typed lookup can try the raw getter and conversion. Actual getter registry, context owner and result cannot be supplied from stored idRef alone.
nonconstant.pathFamilies: Action-context/self/config/save/server-self sources enter the path lane. get_pathRuntime calls PropertyPathDict.GetPath and PropertyPath.Concat and caches a nullable runtime path. Stored path text alone does not prove the selected blackboard, rewritten path or live value.
nonconstant.currentSources: The reviewed reference TryGetValue handles selected current level/entity/script/parent-script/subgame/map sources through keyed blackboard routes, including subgame lookup/cache. This is not a complete implementation of every named current-source selector; in particular the CurrentMissionId selector is not itself a resolution proof. Specialized consumers and context setup remain separate joins.
nonconstant.runtimeBoundary: No nonconstant state-Param resolver invocation, context/registry snapshot, live binding, provider value or source-to-instance creator is in the retained daily capture. Static RGCTX MethodSpec-index candidates remain unadmitted; no 16-byte static entry is treated as an 8-byte runtime slot.

ownerLookup.cache: incoming quest ID to mission ID cache is checked first
ownerLookup.uncached: first ordinal _q# substring yields the prefix; absent delimiter yields empty string
ownerLookup.chronology: ID ownership and current state are not timestamp or causal handoff evidence

eventPublication.questUpdate: Normal admitted Handle_QuestStateUpdate creates/adds or overwrites QuestData.questState before its state-case StartQuest/SucceedQuest calls and ON_QUEST_STATE_CHANGE send. Completion show-data and processing-quest membership helpers can run earlier; this is not whole-handler atomicity.
eventPublication.missionUpdate: Normal admitted Handle_MissionStateUpdate builds a MissionData with incoming missionState and publishes it in the missions dictionary before the Available/Start/Complete lifecycle branch. Earlier completion/show-data and property-map helpers can run before publication.
eventPublication.typedEvents: Quest and mission sends select string plus the respective MissionSystem state enum. Matching OnActivate BindGlobal selects EventData<string,the same enum> and the matching PredefinedEventKeys field.
eventPublication.packet: Selected SendGlobal physical caller puts the incoming reference at packet-relative zero and the incoming Int32 enum at eight, then passes the packet address to Dispatch. This is a direct compiled representation, not an open generic EventData field-layout assertion.
eventPublication.dispatch: Dispatcher looks up the event key and calls EventBinding.Dispatch with the same packet reference. Binding walks the entry-count-bounded delegate list, skips entries marked removed, and calls a struct-delegate helper synchronously. Handler order is runtime registration/list order and can be affected by callbacks.
eventPublication.callback: The selected unregistered compiler delegate helper recognizes the QuestState callback native entry pointer and includes its ID-filter/state-comparison normal branch; other delegates use dynamic calls or specialized branches.
eventPublication.propagation: Active changed decided results are cached before an onResultChange helper and subsequent parent Evaluate. Callback reentrancy/mutation and nested cache quiescence are not proved.
eventPublication.timeline: These are local conditional publication/call relationships. They do not prove server admission, a total mission order, live subscription/IFix state, observed events or any previously unrecorded handoff.

parameterLoading.valueConstructor: The selected complete ordinary reference and Int32-enum value constructors explicitly write paramSource=0, stringPath=null, idRef=-1 and the supplied constValue. The reference-barrier helper is an opaque returning boundary; this proves caller stores, not arbitrary global effects.
parameterLoading.implicitConversion: Selected op_Implicit inline construction explicitly writes paramSource=0, idRef=-1 and the supplied value. An alternate runtime context entry invokes a constructor indirectly. Neither path identifies the construction of a retained live mission Param.
parameterLoading.memoryPack: Each selected concrete Param wrapper accepts a null header or a full property count of four. A non-null object reuses the supplied wrapper or constructs one, then reads constValue, idRef, paramSource and path in that order through reviewed unregistered buffered readers. A non-four header is rejected. The read source overwrites any prior constructor value; omitted source is not a supported partial-header default here. Reader refill/decoding helper effects remain conditional.
parameterLoading.jsonResourceRoute: MissionRuntimeAssetTable.TryGetData consults its cache, then selects DataManager.LoadJson<MissionRuntimeAsset>. The normal loader can use TextAsset JSON deserialization or ResourceManager.DeserializeFromJson. The ResourceManager caller tests formatter availability, dispatches to MemoryPack or JSON readers, and the MemoryPack caller also contains a JSON fallback. Selected bodies do not establish which branch or bytes a live request used.
parameterLoading.jsonDefaults: The normal default JsonHelper settings explicitly configure DefaultValueHandling.Include and NullValueHandling.Ignore. These settings do not identify a Param default creator, constructor, field setter, runtime converter or resulting paramSource for an omitted JSON member.
parameterLoading.activationOrder: Both selected predicates resolve and cache operands first. CheckQuestState binds its global event before querying initial quest state and setting result; CheckMissionState queries initial mission state and sets result before binding its event. Therefore an activation-time true result does not require a later state-change event. Callback/reentrancy and effective activation/subscription remain runtime questions.
